impact.text: Users pay full fees and token amounts for campaigns that can never distribute rewards

precondition_sources.text: A campaign is created with a supplied startTimestamp parameter and a duration of at least 1 hour.
The supplied startTimestamp is in the past relative to block.timestamp, including a campaign that has already fully elapsed before creation.

intent_sources.text: Campaign creation must enforce startTimestamp >= block.timestamp so campaigns cannot be created with a past start time.
